Pale-cyan strips may be a special barrier/transformer, not yet understood. Arrow actions map up/down/left/right; Space/F is ACTION5, likely rotate or interact; ACTION7 undo. Need infer movement semantics from animation before committing a route.

[Before action · write GUIDE.md]
8-level grid puzzle, logical step/cell = 24 px (three 8 px visual squares). Arrow actions translate black and gray pieces: Up/Down move both in the same vertical direction; Left/Right move black with the input and gray in the opposite horizontal direction about the fixed pale-cyan vertical axis. Pieces can pass/overlap at the axis. Black is a rigid 5-cell L with a white center marker in every cell; initial orientation has arms west+south. Yellow is a fixed 5-cell L target with arms east+south. Gray began as an 8-cell thick L (top row 4, next two rows 2). During the first rightward crossing, overlap permanently removed the gray's left 3-cell vertical column, leaving an exact 5-cell L congruent with the yellow target (confirmed after pieces fully separated). Thus black likely acts as a cutter/negative piece and gray is material to sculpt then place. ACTION5 and clicks caused no visible change; Space may be an invisible mode/confirm but two toggles did not affect later mirrored motion. Need discover how to place the carved gray on yellow or what completion condition is. Current turn 10: after Down once and Right six times total, black target-incongruent L bbox about x288..360,y144..216; carved gray target-congruent L bbox x144..216,y144..216. Yellow bbox x408..480,y360..432. Both shapes remain vertically aligned; reverse horizontal travel would force another crossing unless a mechanic changes relative vertical motion.

[Before action · write GUIDE.md]

Level 1 clean successful route happened in object mode: move black Left 5, then Down 10, placing its reflection on yellow. Level 2: default mirror mode, move vertical mirror Left 2, Space to object mode, Down 8; completed. Gray visual can look expanded across the 24px-thick mirror at an initial boundary, but reflection geometry is the key.
Level 3 has a horizontal mirror center y396 and two black shapes. Four yellow silhouettes form two mirror-paired goals about desired axis y228: left black L (bbox96..192,y168..264) must reach bottom-mid L goal bbox264..360,y336..432, delta(+7,+7); right black T (bbox360..456,y216..264) must reach bottom-left T goal bbox72..168,y336..384, delta(-12,+5). Their reflections then occupy corresponding top goals. First move mirror Up 7 in default mirror mode (center396->228). Then Space/object mode and select/move the two black shapes independently, likely via ACTION6 clicks; current blue center holes may turn white for selection.
